worktree.setup: effigy skill run --path "${NORTHSTAR_SKILL_PATH:-$HOME/.agents/skills/northstar}" paseo:worktree -- prepare && effigy bootstrap:deps && effigy skill run --path "${NORTHSTAR_SKILL_PATH:-$HOME/.agents/skills/northstar}" paseo:worktree -- link

branchName.instructions: Use worker/<short-kebab-outcome> for implementation lanes. Other bounded changes may use a short kebab-case name, optionally with a purpose prefix. One branch per concurrent thread. Open against main.

commitMessage.instructions: Use a short imperative subject. Add a conventional type (docs, chore, fix) when it helps; omit scope unless it adds signal. Put the why in the body when the subject is not enough.

pullRequest.instructions: Lead with the shipped outcome. Name governing docs or cards when they exist. Include validation evidence and unresolved items. Target main. Do not merge from the worker lane.
